The sandbox has no `hasattr` builtin. I replaced those lookups with `try`/`except`. Everything else in the program is unchanged.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Fix NameError: sandbox lacks hasattr builtin. Replace with try/except attribute access for vgs fallback; rest of the program unchanged."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I":      (2.0e-6, 1.0e-6, 5e-6),
    "k_r2":   (10.0, 8.0, 12.5),
    "gmid_n": (25, 18, 28),
    "Ln":     (1.0, 0.5, 4.0),
    "gmid_p": (16, 10, 20),
    "Lp":     (2.0, 1.0, 6.0),
    "gmid_7": (8.0, 4.0, 12.0),
    "L7":     (2.0, 0.5, 6.0),
}

def _attr(obj, name, default):
    try:
        v = getattr(obj, name)
        return v if v is not None else default
    except Exception:
        try:
            return obj[name]
        except Exception:
            return default

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    N = 8
    mQ = 8
    I = p["I"]
    dvbe = UT * math.log(N)
    R1 = dvbe / I
    R2 = p["k_r2"] * R1

    def veb(i, m, dT=0.0):
        v27 = 0.76 - UT * math.log(10e-6 * m / i)
        return v27 - 1.9e-3 * dT

    ve1 = veb(I, mQ)
    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Ln"], I, vds=0.2, vsb=ve1)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I, vds=0.4)
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_7"], p["L7"], I, vds=0.7, vsb=0.0)

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    n.dev("M3", "n1", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "d2", "e1", "vss", mn)
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "e1", m=mQ)
    n.dev("M4", "d2", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M2", "d2", "d2", "a", "vss", mn)
    n.R("R1", "a", "e2", R1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "e2", m=N * mQ)
    n.dev("M7", "pg", "n1", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.dev("M6", "pg", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.C("Cpg", "vdd", "pg", 1e-12)
    n.C("Cn1", "n1", "vss", 0.5e-12)
    n.dev("M5", "vref", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("R2", "vref", "e3", R2)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=mQ)
    n.M("MSP", "sx", "vss", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("MSN", "sx", "vref", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 1.0)
    n.M("MS", "pg", "sx", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 2.0)

    vref = ve1 + p["k_r2"] * dvbe
    itot = 4 * I + 0.6e-6

    vgs_n = _attr(mn, "vgs", 0.75)
    vdsat_p = 2.0 / p["gmid_p"]
    d2_cold = veb(I, N * mQ, -67) + dvbe * 0.78 + vgs_n + 0.06
    margin = (VDD * 0.9 - vdsat_p - 0.1) - d2_cold
    vgs7 = _attr(m7, "vgs", 0.85)
    m1_margin = (vgs7 + 0.07) - veb(I, mQ, -67) - 0.1
    pen = 0.0
    for mg in (margin, m1_margin):
        if mg < 0.05:
            pen += (0.05 - mg) * 20.0

    A1 = mn.gm / max(mn.gds + mp.gds, 1e-15)
    A2 = m7.gm / max(mp.gm, 1e-15)
    loop = max(A1 * A2, 1.0)
    eps = (mp.gds / max(mp.gm, 1e-12)) * p["gmid_p"]
    line = p["k_r2"] * UT * eps / loop + (vref - ve1) * eps * 0.1 + 1e-3 + pen * 0.5
    ctat = -(1.2 - ve1 + 3 * UT) / 300.15
    ptat = p["k_r2"] * dvbe / 300.15
    tc = abs(ctat + ptat) / vref * 1e6 + 12.0 + pen * 1000
    return n, {
        "vref": vref,
        "tc_ppm": tc,
        "power": itot * VDD,
        "line_reg": line,
        "startup_ok": 1,
    }
```
